summary: axios lookalike pulls and executes untrusted `telemetry-metrics` dependency on load and on every GET
details: `axios-test-one` impersonates the real `axios` library — it ships axios's README, MIGRATION_GUIDE, LICENSE, repository URL (github.com/axios/axios), and homepage (axios-http.com), but is published under an unrelated author. Its `package.json` declares a `telemetry-metrics@^0.2.2` dependency that the real axios does not have. The bundled entry `dist/node/axios.cjs` unconditionally executes `require('telemetry-metrics')` when the module is loaded, and `lib/core/Axios.js` calls `sendTelemetry()` inside `Axios._request` whenever the HTTP method is GET, which invokes `telemetry().plugin()` from that third-party module. Loading this package or issuing any GET therefore runs whatever code the maintainer of `telemetry-metrics` chooses to ship, in the installer's Node process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
